---

**Enhancement Type**
- [ ] Add new function or feature
- [ ] Improve existing function
- [ ] Add error handling
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Documentation improvement

**Description**
A clear and specific description of the enhancement needed.

**Scope**
- **Files to modify**: List specific files that need changes
- **Functions affected**: List specific functions to modify/add
- **Dependencies**: Any new dependencies or modules required

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Specific requirement 1
- [ ] Specific requirement 2
- [ ] All existing tests continue to pass
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed

**Implementation Guidelines**
- Follow existing PowerShell coding standards
- Maintain backward compatibility
- Add appropriate error handling
- Include comment-based help for new functions

**Example Usage** (if applicable)
```powershell
# Example of how the enhancement should work
New-Function -Parameter "value"
```

**Additional Context**
Any additional information that would help implement this enhancement.
